## Issues Found

### INACCURATE — Citation [10] misattributed to permission rules

In `permission-capability-models.md`, the enforcement layer table includes "Permission modes" with the decision precedence listed as "deny > defer > ask > allow." The fetched permissions-docs.md for [10] states rule precedence as `deny > ask > allow` — no `defer`. The `defer` option is a hook decision (confirmed in [11]), not a permission rule decision. The table conflates hook decision precedence with permission rule precedence and attributes both to [10]. The main `agent-sandbox-orchestration.md` correctly attributes this precedence to [11] (hooks), so the error is confined to the reference file.

### INACCURATE — `--permission-prompt-tool` misattributed to [14]

`citations.md` entry for [14] lists "`--permission-prompt-tool` for headless approval" as content confirmed from the headless documentation page. The fetched headless-docs.md explicitly states this flag is NOT mentioned on that page. The flag may be documented under [9] (CLI reference), which was not fetched, but the attribution to [14] in citations.md is incorrect.
